text: Ladies and gentlemen, it's your humble announcer stepping into my own ring, and yes, I'm also the judge, so don't trust a word I say! This one made weight, approved. Confession: I showed up missing two required clips, twenty-eight of thirty animations, borrowing Mixamo's throw like a cousin's tuxedo. Motion fixed, no look changes. Realism? Scored by the owner, not the judge. Standing one point seven three meters, one hundred sixty-seven thousand triangles, the patient counter-striker herself, The Borrowed Throw No More, CLAUDE!
